summary: Two prior findings remain unresolved because revised text retains contradictory or incorrect statements.

findings.title: `--force` would log non-takeovers
findings.detail: The ruling and T3 correctly require a stolen/forced outcome, but the Assumptions table still says to log whenever `r.force` is set. That contradiction could still prescribe false events for free or self-held locks.

findings.title: Anchor miscounts fixes and rulings
findings.detail: The anchor still describes fourteen fixes plus two rulings instead of eleven code/doc fixes, two rulings, and one already-fixed closure. G12 explains the arithmetic elsewhere but does not correct the anchor.
